MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL WEATHER ADVISORY FOR THE INDIAN OCEAN
REISSUED/190300Z-191800ZOCT2026//
RMKS/
1. NORTH INDIAN OCEAN AREA (MALAY PENINSULA WEST TO COAST OF AFRICA):
   A. TROPICAL CYCLONE SUMMARY: NONE.
   B. TROPICAL DISTURBANCE SUMMARY:
      (1) THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 96A) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR
6.9N 58.3E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 4.0N 57.0E, APPROXIMATELY 755 NM
NORTHEAST OF MOGADISHU. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED IMAGERY (EIR)
DEPICTS AN AREA OF CONSOLIDATED MID-LEVEL TURNING WITH CONVECTION THAT
HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY SHEARED OVER THE LAST SIX HOURS. AN 180443Z
METOP-B ASCAT DEPICTS A CONSOLIDATING LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER
(LLCC) WITH ENHANCED WINDS ON THE SOUTHERN PORTION. ENVIRONMENTAL
ANALYSIS REVEALS LOW TO MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (15-20KTS), WARM
SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (28 TO 29C), AND RADIAL OUTFLOW ALOFT. GLOBAL
MODELS ARE IN AGREEMENT ON 96A REMAINING QUASI-STATIONARY FOR THE NEXT
24 HOURS BEFORE TRACKING GENERALLY NORTHEASTWARD, BUT ARE IN LESS
AGREEMENT ON A GRADUAL DEVELOPMENT INTO A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL
CYCLONE. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED BETWEEN 23-28
KTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1009MB.THE
POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN
THE NEXT 24 HOURS REMAINS LOW.
      (2) NO OTHER SUSPECT AREAS.
   C. SUBTROPICAL SYSTEM SUMMARY: NONE.
2. SOUTH INDIAN OCEAN AREA (135E WEST TO COAST OF AFRICA):
   A. TROPICAL CYCLONE SUMMARY: NONE.
   B. TROPICAL DISTURBANCE SUMMARY:
      (1) AN AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 93S) HAS PERSISTED NEAR 3.2N
57.1E, APPROXIMATELY 100 NM NORTHEAST OF SEYCHELLES. ANIMATED ENHANCED
INFRARED IMAGERY (EIR) DEPICTS AN AREA OF PARTIALLY EXPOSED, BROAD
TURNING ON THE NORTHEASTERN SIDE WHILE THE SOUTHWESTERN FLANK IS
OBSCURED BY FLARING CONVECTION. A 181723Z METOP-B ASCAT PASS DEPICTS
AN AREA OF ELONGATED TURNING WITH ENHANCED WINDS ON THE NORTHERN AND
SOUTHERN SIDES, SOMEWHAT DISPLACED FROM THE ASSESSED CENTER OF
TURNING. AN 182117Z AMSR3 MICROWAVE PASS DEPICTS AN ELONGATED BUT
CONSOLIDATING LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION (LLC). ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS
REVEALS LOW TO MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (15-20KTS), WARM SEA
SURFACE TEMPERATURES (28-29C), AND MODERATE RADIAL OUTFLOW ALOFT.
GLOBAL MODELS ARE IN AGREEMENT ON 93S TRACKING SOUTHWESTWARD. MAXIMUM
SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED BETWEEN 18-22 KTS. MINIMUM SEA
LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1010MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE
DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS
IS LOW.
   (2) NO OTHER SUSPECT AREAS.
   C. SUBTROPICAL SYSTEM SUMMARY: NONE.
3. JUSTIFICATION FOR REISSUE: ADDED LOW AREA IN PARA. 2.B.(1).//
